svg.title: Double surgeon's knot — how to tie it
svg.desc: Double surgeon's knot, in 5 steps. Lay the two lines alongside each other with a long overlap. Form a loop with both lines together. Pass both tag ends through the loop twice. Wet it and pull all four ends at once to seat it evenly. Trim both tags.
svg.text: ~88% of line strength · leader to tippet
